method: Six DSI pad-center chords, Euclidean minimum spanning tree for each non-GND/non-NC net, and straight-edge crossing proxy. These are not routed lengths, actual ratsnest topology, actual vias or SI validation.

B_same_edge_selected.status: Full native ERC/DRC/parity/model and boundary checks completed
B_same_edge_selected.decision: Selected: cable access, broad DSI crossover/tuning area, SW separation and short critical chords.

nominal_exit_corrections: J6 moved inside PCB, C13 shifted for clearance
A_orthogonal_user_concept.status: Concept geometry/courtyard check only; full DRC/3D not run for alternative
A_orthogonal_user_concept.decision: Feasible concept, but DSI takes a corner; original power cluster has long SW, FB and output-return chords. Cable directions require changes.

C_opposite_edges_early_reject.status: Connector-only screening; remaining component layout not optimized or accepted
